sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New, and off unless you switch it on: springsteenlyrics.com collection and bootleg lists. Turn on ⚙️ Settings → 🎸 springsteenlyrics.com → "Enable on springsteenlyrics.com collection and bootleg lists". Every collection list (collection.php?cmd=list…) and bootleg list (bootlegs.php?cmd=list…) then gets the usual toolbar and one button. On a bootleg list this works with any format, country, date or other filter you picked on the site. On a collection list, only the "Official albums" category works so far. The button fetches every page of the list and turns the item cards into one table, which you can filter, sort, export and save.

Collection columns: Cover, Title, Version, Label, Cat. no., Format, Country, Release date, Original year and Copies. Bootleg columns: Cover, Title, Label, Date, First date (the first date as 1967-09-16, so it sorts by date), Location, Format, Duration (sorts by length; an unknown one shows as ?:?? and stays last), Lossy, Artwork and Info file. Only what each list card shows is used, and no item page is opened.
While the setting is off, the script leaves springsteenlyrics.com pages exactly as they are.
